title: Audit intake
description: The answers to the audit's Stage 0 questions, given in a file so that a run needs no interview. A person fills it in once and reuses it for re-audits; an evaluation run reads it unattended. report.py init copies it into the report's run_context. Rules a schema cannot express are in SCHEMA.md.

intake_version.description: Version of this schema. 0.x versions may break between releases.

target_path.description: The repository to audit. A directory the audit only reads.

harness.description: The agent harness that runs the recipe, as the operator names it. Self-reported and unverified.

model.description: The model the harness uses, as the operator names it. Self-reported and unverified.

provider_exposure_acknowledged.description: The operator confirms that the model provider receives whatever the agent reads from the target. There is no way to start without it.

kind.description: How the agent reaches a code index: an MCP server, a command-line tool, or not at all.

name.description: The index tool's name, for example codebase-memory-mcp. Needed when kind is mcp or cli.

allow_install.description: Whether the recipe may install or build the index for the target. Off when absent. An installed index lives outside the target.

probes.description: Which of the target's own commands the engine's probe runner may execute. None when absent. A target's commands run its code.

excluded.description: Paths the audit leaves out, relative to the target.

known_components.description: Component roots the operator already knows, relative to the target.

confirmation_policy.description: interactive asks the person about each finding. defer-all leaves every disposition pending. accept-all confirms every finding and is allowed only with eval_mode.

repo_label.description: A short name for the repository, used in output file names. Lower case letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen, at most 32 characters. When absent the run derives one from the name of the target directory; see SCHEMA.md, Output files.

output_dir.description: Where the report and its draft are written. Outside the target.

eval_mode.description: True for a headless evaluation run. Its report is stamped eval_mode and can never be final. False when absent.
